Class FrameParser

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.connection.FrameParser
All Implemented Interfaces:
StreamFrameParser
public class FrameParser extends Object implements StreamFrameParser
State machine for parsing Meshtastic serial and TCP frames.

Frame format: [0x94][0xC3][len_msb][len_lsb][payload...].

  • Method Details

    • processByte

      public byte[] processByte(byte b)
      Processes one byte from the incoming stream. Advances the state machine through start bytes, length bytes, and payload. Frames with length <= 0 or greater than MAX_PACKET_SIZE are discarded.
      Specified by:
      processByte in interface StreamFrameParser
      Parameters:
      b - next byte
      Returns:
      complete protobuf payload when a frame is finished, otherwise null
